title: SCOBY-D1 Consolidated Research Map: Baselines, Chitin Reinforcement, Electro-Assisted Growth, and Structural Matrix Engineering
supersedes: loose experimental notes only; does not supersede or rewrite branch-level evidence records
scope: Unified D1 research map for bacterial-cellulose/SCOBY matrix engineering. The map consolidates baseline architectures, exogenous and biological chitin reinforcement, matched-fraction reinforcement comparison, DC-field electrosynthesis hypotheses, electrolysis-derived gas-conditioning hypotheses, freeze-thaw structural engineering, and future branch placeholders. Every branch retains independent evidence status, controls, safety boundaries, and claim ceilings.

epistemic_ladder.rule: No branch may skip epistemic levels. Simulation is never an experimental result.

BRANCH_01_BASELINE_ARCHITECTURES.description: GEN0 no-tension, GEN1 tension-dried, GEN2 cross-laminated, and GEN3 linen-reinforced architectures establish the reference envelope for mechanics, moisture behavior, dimensional stability, process time, and material balance.

BRANCH_02_FUNGAL_CHITIN_BIOCOMPOSITE.description: Contained research branch testing whether a characterized fungal biomass/chitin-containing phase can become incorporated into a bacterial-cellulose matrix without net loss of matrix integrity.
BRANCH_02_FUNGAL_CHITIN_BIOCOMPOSITE.critical_correction: Random household mold is not a standardized inoculum. Any viable fungal work belongs under an approved laboratory SOP and containment framework.

BRANCH_03_EXOGENOUS_SHRIMP_CHITIN.description: Test whether characterized crustacean-derived chitin can coexist with bacterial-cellulose formation and subsequently become physically incorporated into the pellicle.
BRANCH_03_EXOGENOUS_SHRIMP_CHITIN.first_screening_rule: Use recorded, validated material characterization and matched untreated control; avoid interpreting visual co-deposition as true matrix incorporation.
BRANCH_03_EXOGENOUS_SHRIMP_CHITIN.priority_rationale: Potentially lower biological complexity than fungal incorporation, while retaining a strong resource-recovery hypothesis.

BRANCH_04_BASALT_VS_CHITIN_COMPARISON.description: Compare chitin and basalt only after controlling for filler volume fraction, particle/fiber geometry, dispersion, matrix density, and interfacial condition.

BRANCH_05_ELECTROSYNTHESIS_DC_FIELD.description: Explore whether an applied DC electric environment during pellicle formation changes bacterial-cellulose organization or growth symmetry.

BRANCH_06_ELECTROLYSIS_GAS_AERATION.description: Separately investigate whether controlled external gas conditioning changes pellicle growth, oxygen availability, or matrix density. This branch is intentionally separated from direct-electrode experiments so gas effects are not conflated with electric-field effects.
BRANCH_06_ELECTROLYSIS_GAS_AERATION.safety_boundary: Hydrogen-containing gas streams require engineered containment, ignition-source control, appropriate ventilation, and laboratory-approved gas handling. No improvised mixed-gas experiments are authorized by this registry.

BRANCH_07_FREEZE_THAW_MATRIX_ENGINEERING.description: Explore controlled freeze-thaw treatment as a route to ice-templated macroporosity and altered sorption/transport properties.

BRANCH_08_SOLVENT_PRETREATMENT.description: Maintain the solvent-exchange branch as a process-history hypothesis affecting water content, drying behavior, and downstream thermal response.
BRANCH_08_SOLVENT_PRETREATMENT.mandatory_rule: Solvent vapor environment must not be equated with inert or reducing atmosphere without measurement.

BRANCH_09_TECHNICAL_ACETATE.description: Register acetate generation and technical sodium-acetate recovery as a separate chemical-production line with identity, purity, mass-balance, and manufacturability gates.

BRANCH_10_FOOD_ADDITIVE_BOUNDARY.description: Keep technical acetate and any possible E262 food-additive pathway strictly separated. Molecular identity alone does not establish regulatory food-grade compliance.

CHITIN_REINFORCEMENT.summary: Two distinct routes are under study: biological incorporation of a characterized fungal chitin-containing phase and abiotic/exogenous incorporation of crustacean-derived chitin. Both require independent confirmation of chitin presence, distribution, interface behavior, and net mechanical effect.
established: chitin can participate in polymer-composite structures
plausible: cellulose-chitin interfacial interactions may alter toughness and wet behavior
speculative: in situ fungal growth will outperform controlled exogenous chitin
shrimp-derived chitin will reinforce SCOBY at useful loading without inhibiting pellicle formation

ELECTROCHEMICAL_INTERVENTIONS.summary: DC-field and gas-conditioning branches are deliberately separated because direct electrochemical effects can mimic or obscure a true field-orientation mechanism.
ELECTROCHEMICAL_INTERVENTIONS.rule: A mechanical anisotropy observed during DC treatment is not automatically evidence of fibril alignment.

STRUCTURE_PROPERTY_CAUSALITY.rule: Any claimed reinforcement must identify the causal link between process change and measured property change.

RESOURCE_RECOVERY.summary: SCOBY may support cascading use of fermentation outputs, cellulose biomass, and acetate-rich process streams. Resource value is a quantitative hypothesis, not a default zero-waste claim.

BALLISTIC_BOUNDARY.rule: No ballistic protection claim may be inferred from tensile, puncture, tear, or numerical models. Any future impact testing belongs in a separate certified, reviewed test program.

statistical_framework.preferred: Independent batches rather than only technical repeats
statistical_framework.baseline_comparison: GEN0 and/or matched processed control depending on branch
statistical_framework.multiple_comparison_rule: Predefine family of comparisons and correction method before analysis; do not select p-values retrospectively.
statistical_framework.blinding: Where practical, blind sample identifiers during mechanical characterization and image scoring.

safety_matrix.DC_ELECTRICAL_WORK: CURRENT_LIMITS, INSULATION, ENGINEERED SETUP, AND APPROPRIATE LAB SAFETY CONTROLS REQUIRED
safety_matrix.hydrogen_or_oxygen_gas: NO_IMPROVISED_MIXED_GAS SYSTEMS; ENGINEERED GAS HANDLING REQUIRED
safety_matrix.microwave_or_high_temperature_carbonizat: NOT AUTHORIZED AS A HOUSEHOLD PROCEDURE BY THIS MAP

claim_ceiling_matrix.mechanical_claim: Requires structure-property evidence and matched control.
claim_ceiling_matrix.wet_resistance_claim: Requires wet-state replication and dimensional data.
claim_ceiling_matrix.biodegradability_claim: Requires defined test conditions and kinetics.
claim_ceiling_matrix.environmental_claim: Requires comparative material/energy/water accounting; LCA for strong superiority claims.
claim_ceiling_matrix.economic_claim: Requires measured yield, labor, consumables, energy, and waste costs.
claim_ceiling_matrix.food_claim: Requires separate regulated food-safety and specification pathway.
claim_ceiling_matrix.ballistic_claim: Not admitted from D1 screening metrics or simulations.
claim_ceiling_matrix.scalability_claim: Requires process reproducibility across independent batches and scale levels.

priority_roadmap.rule: Baseline data must precede strong comparative claims. High-risk branches do not outrank low-risk baseline characterization merely because their simulated upside is larger.

simulations_and_predictions.rule: Simulation artifacts are frozen prediction objects. Real results must be compared against them without retrospective parameter tuning.
simulations_and_predictions.prediction_to_observation_transition: Only a registered, reproducible real experiment can move a branch above hypothesis/model status.

data_provenance_rules.raw_data: Must be preserved separately from interpreted summaries.
data_provenance_rules.sample_identity: Unique identifiers required for every physical sample.
data_provenance_rules.instrument_metadata: Record instrument, method, settings, calibration status, and operator where available.
data_provenance_rules.image_metadata: Record sample ID, orientation, location, magnification, and acquisition date.
data_provenance_rules.hashing: Use cryptographic hashes for exact artifact/data integrity; never use a hash as evidence of scientific truth.

change_control.status_changes: Must include reason, evidence reference, and new gate state.
change_control.protocol_changes: Create a new version rather than silently editing an active historical record.
change_control.simulation_changes: Frozen simulation records must not be rewritten after real-data observation.
change_control.reproducibility: Any branch promoted beyond HYPOTHESIS_UNVERIFIED must point to the exact raw-data artifact set supporting promotion.

master_decision_logic.if_baseline_fails_reproducibility: Pause comparative reinforcement claims and repair baseline protocol.
master_decision_logic.if_chitin_changes_growth: Separate biological compatibility from mechanical reinforcement; do not conflate growth inhibition with material strengthening.
master_decision_logic.if_chitin_signal_present_but_mechanics_f: Classify as compositionally incorporated but mechanically non-beneficial under tested conditions.
master_decision_logic.if_electro_field_changes_growth_but_not_: Classify as electrochemical/environmental effect until direct orientation evidence exists.
master_decision_logic.if_simulation_matches_real_data: Simulation remains a prediction record; real experiment receives independent status.
master_decision_logic.if_simulation_fails: Record model failure as evidence about the hypothesis space; do not retrofit the simulation.
master_decision_logic.if_multiple_branches_improve_the_same_pr: Run orthogonal comparison to determine whether mechanism is shared, additive, or confounded.
master_decision_logic.if_any_branch_passes_screening: Promote only to branch-specific Stage 2 validation, never directly to application claim.

master_gate.name: D1_MASTER_ADMISSION_GATE
master_gate.promotion_rule: No branch reaches CLAIM unless every applicable requirement is explicitly satisfied or formally waived with documented rationale.

next_master_gate: Record the first real experimental observations from any active branch, preserve raw data and sample identities, and update the corresponding branch artifact plus this master map. Simulation and hypothesis records remain unchanged.
authority_rule: This consolidated map is an index and governance layer. It does not turn independent hypotheses into collective evidence, does not certify any material, and does not authorize food, medical, agricultural, ballistic, or hazardous-process claims.
integrity_note: SHA-256 must be computed from the exact UTF-8 bytes of this final file. Git commit SHA and Git blob SHA must not be represented as SHA-256 content hashes.
